import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, ptr;
        int src, sink;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            src = s;
            sink = t;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int f) {
            int revU = g.get(u).size();
            int revV = g.get(v).size();
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, f, revV));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, revU));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            ArrayDeque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(src);
            level[src] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(cur)) {
                    if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.cap != 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[cur] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int cur, int pushed) {
            if (cur == sink) return pushed;
            for (int i = ptr[cur]; i < g.get(cur).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = g.get(cur).get(i);
                if (level[e.to] == level[cur] + 1 && e.cap != 0) {
                    int tr = dfs(e.to, Math.min(pushed, e.cap));
                    if (tr != 0) {
                        e.cap -= tr;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += tr;
                        return tr;
                    }
                }
                ptr[cur]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(src, 1_000_000_000);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, tLimit;
    static char[][] grid;
    static char[][] exits;
    static int[][] dist;
    static int sy, sx;
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static void solve() {
        ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sy, sx});
        dist[sy][sx] = 1;
        int depth = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q.size();
            for (int it = 0; it < sz; it++) {
                int[] p = q.poll();
                int y = p[0], x = p[1];
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = y + dy[d];
                    int nx = x + dx[d];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (dist[ny][nx] != 0 || grid[ny][nx] == 'Y') continue;
                    dist[ny][nx] = depth;
                    q.add(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
            depth++;
            depth = Math.min(depth, tLimit);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        tLimit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        grid = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        // read two blank lines (or any lines) as in original code
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline after last grid row
        sc.nextLine(); // first blank line
        sc.nextLine(); // second blank line
        exits = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            exits[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        dist = new int[n][n];
        // find start
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sy = i;
                    sx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        solve();

        int nodes = 0;
        int[][][] nodeId = new int[n][n][65];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '0' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    if (dist[i][j] == 0) dist[i][j] = tLimit;
                    for (int t = 0; t < dist[i][j]; t++) {
                        nodeId[i][j][t] = ++nodes;
                    }
                }
                if (exits[i][j] >= '1' && exits[i][j] <= '9') {
                    nodeId[i][j][dist[i][j]] = ++nodes;
                }
            }
        }

        int INF = 1_000_000_000;
        int S = 0;
        int T = nodes + 3;
        Dinic mf = new Dinic(nodes + 5, S, T);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(S, nodeId[i][j][0], grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[d];
                    int nx = j + dx[d];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (grid[ny][nx] == 'Y' || grid[ny][nx] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t = 0; ; t++) {
                        if (nodeId[i][j][t] == 0) break;
                        if (t == dist[i][j] && exits[i][j] >= '1' && exits[i][j] <= '9') break;
                        if (nodeId[ny][nx][t+1] != 0) {
                            mf.addEdge(nodeId[i][j][t], nodeId[ny][nx][t+1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (exits[i][j] >= '1' && exits[i][j] <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < dist[i][j]; t++) {
                        mf.addEdge(nodeId[i][j][t], nodeId[i][j][t+1], INF);
                    }
                    mf.addEdge(nodeId[i][j][dist[i][j]], T, exits[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
